headline: Same-store growth accelerates, big buyback executed
summary_short: Core FFO rose 4.3% to $2.17 per share as same-store NOI grew 4.6%. Extra Space repurchased $327.1M of its shares in the quarter.
summary_long: Same-store revenue increased 2.7% while same-store expenses fell 1.8%. Occupancy ended at 94.0% versus 93.7% a year ago. Diluted EPS rose 50% against a year-ago quarter that included a loss on real estate assets sold. The company bought four operating stores for $48.6M, originated $19.5M of bridge loans and now manages 2,371 stores for third parties and joint ventures. The quarterly dividend was $1.62 per share. Noah Springer will become CEO on January 1, 2027.
confidence_notes: Core FFO is a non-GAAP measure as defined by the company. Revenue growth computed from $889.8M vs $858.5M in the release. FFO growth computed from $2.12 vs $2.01. No guidance was captured in the portion of the release read.

drivers.explanation: Same-store revenue rose 2.7% while same-store expenses fell 1.8%.
The prior-year quarter included a loss from real estate assets sold in 2025.
CEO cites pricing, customer acquisition and growth capabilities, plus opportunistic share repurchases, as drivers of strong results.
